title: Scanning Boolean pairs
statement: Define a function that takes an optional previous Boolean value and a list of Boolean values, and returns either no result or a list. For a list beginning with false, true, it returns no result if the previous value is false, and otherwise returns the remaining list; for a list beginning with two equal values, it recursively scans the remaining list with that value as the previous value. It returns no result in every other case.
